name: ai-native-video-editor
description: An open-source local-first video editor with an iPad-first PWA and AI editing engine.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @aive/core --workspace @aive/mcp && npm run build:renderer --workspace synthcut-by-relo && npm run build --workspace ai-video-editor-ipad
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core packages/mcp && npm run typecheck --workspace synthcut-by-relo && npm run typecheck --workspace ai-video-editor-ipad
